name: PIC18F4455-IP

kicad_errors.detail: the Datasheet property points to 39760d.pdf, which is the PIC18F2450/4450 data sheet - a different device. The correct document is DS39632 (PIC18F2455/2550/4455/4550). This matters more than a cosmetic link error: the 4450 has no MSSP, so pins 33 and 34 lack SDI/SDA and SCK/SCL and pin 26 lacks SDO. Anyone following the link to check a pinout gets the wrong peripheral mapping on three pins

Both symbols independently typed VDDCORE as power_out, which is only stated in the colour legend (REGULATED OUTPUT SUPPLY, distinct from INPUT SUPPLY) - the same legend that carries the oscillator functions KiCad missed.
